claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PD-123319 is a selective AT2 angiotensin receptor antagonist and is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent at 2.5 uM in cancer cell lines; no dominant off-target or physicochemical killing mechanism is anticipated.
